question.question: Would Calvin enjoy performing at the Hollywood Bowl?

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text: - Dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them; hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact [S3T9].

- On 2023-05-31, said performing live "always fuels my soul" — he loves "the rush and connection with the crowd," "the feeling's indescribable — it's an absolute high"; at a concert "Everyone is part of it, it's like one big harmony." The chat came with concert photos (a large crowd taking pictures of a concert; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band performing on stage) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T12][S7T13][S7T14].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job." [S14T8].
- On 2023-08-14, said the tour's closing show was "buzzing" — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" — and that he's "all about spreading joy with my art" [S14T10].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-23, in the closing exchange about concerts: music "brings us together and creates unforgettable memories," and it's "unbeatable in terms of the energy it brings"; he called concerts what he lives for — "the indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd is just amazing!" — and the rush of connecting with everyone at a concert is a feeling that's "unbeatable" (complements his 2023-05-31 "fuels my soul" remark above; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T26][S25T28][S25T30].

- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of himself performing at a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table in a nightclub) with someone he admires — "So amazing!" (Dave: "You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?") (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: performing "with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (complements his long-stated "fuels my soul"/concerts-are-what-he-lives-for remarks above; closing exchange details in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T9].

- On 2023-08-31, when Dave asked how the end of the tour was, Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); when Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, Calvin said it was "a dream come true" — the energy was incredible, he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal" [S16T2][S16T3][S16T4].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-19, shared photos while telling Dave about the tour: of how he performed on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights — "that was awesome!"), of him and Frank Ocean together on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall — "we perfectly look together on stage"), and of the audience (a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium — "Look at this crowd, that was insane!") [S24T1][S24T5][S24T7].

- On 2023-09-15, reacted to Dave's update that the night before (2023-09-14) he and his band had been jamming: "When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling." He asked if Dave had recordings of the sessions, and when Dave said no ("way too into it and totally forgot"), said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds." Dave also told him he attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band on stage with bright lights); Calvin: "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!" (Dave's details in the Rock band and Music sections of /memories/dave.md) [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-11-17 (later in the same chat with Dave, after sharing his Japanese-garden photo), announced more great news: he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and he'll fill Dave in on all the details later (a Boston show on top of his other Boston activity, e.g., the 2023-11-16 gala and the 2023-11-13 Boston performance, see ## Boston trip); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston." (Calvin's side of the closing exchange in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Music, Photography, and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md) [S30T20].
